author: Domnm

title: Some issues on iphone
body:
Love this app. Easy to use and you can find everything you need. Could be improved: memory of what was written.
Issue on iphone (using 15 pro max). On widget: 1) all you can see is white screen until you press on it. General bugs: 2) when you add new stuff on calendar and want to drag it up or down somehow it goes way more than you want.
3) adding event and dragging to the time you want there is a bug that it keeps the time on what you pressed at first time. 
Overall everything is good. These bugs appear after new updates.
author: ZifPif

title: replace the undo button
body:
i want to address a specific issue. after you tap Mark completed, there is a feedback popup, that has an Undo button right at the place where the Plus button is located.
so it happened to me multiple times that I mark completed, and then want to create a new task, but hit Undo instead.
come on ux/ui designers, there should be a way to place those better. 
thanks!
